label: Bible Study
prompt: Be ye _____ of me, even as I also am of Christ.
verse: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
note: Paul's bold invitation — copy me, as I copy Christ.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is _____ before God?
verse: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
note: Five sparrows for two farthings — Luke's bulk-deal price — and still God forgets not one.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Meekness, _____: against such there is no law.
verse: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
note: The fruit of the Spirit ends with meekness and temperance — self-control — and there's no law against any of it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I have set _____ upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
verse: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the LORD, keep not silence,
note: Isaiah posts watchmen on Jerusalem's walls who are told never to stop reminding God.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For our light _____, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
verse: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
note: Paul's scales: a 'light affliction' for a moment versus 'an eternal weight of glory' — no contest.
